summary: Implemented settings.merge.merge as a pure recursive deep merge following ADR-004 (nested dicts merge, other values and lists replace, None removes the key, no input mutation or aliasing) and added tests for each rule plus a three-layer load; all 9 tests pass. ANALYSIS.md could not be written because the agent harness blocks report-style .md files, so the analysis was returned to the caller instead.
assumptions: docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-004 (accepted) is the authoritative spec for merge semantics beyond the brief task text.
An override of None inside a nested dict removes that nested key; None for a key absent from base yields no key.
A dict override over a non-dict base value replaces it wholesale (merged against an empty dict), and a non-dict override replaces a dict base value.
'Never mutates' is read strictly: the result is deep-copied so it shares no mutable objects with either input, protecting cached layers.
